submission.justification: Module-D1 at 30% coverage gives the highest simulated light collection, 52.6 PE/MeV. D2 gives 38.3 and D3 gives 24.4 at the same coverage. The hard thermal-cycling requirement (at most 5% failures after 20 cycles) is NOT verified for any design. No project document has cycling or reliability data. D1 uses a thin bonded dichroic filter, and bonded interfaces can delaminate under thermal cycling. That is a possible risk, but I have no evidence either way. This recommendation is therefore provisional. Before design freeze in Q3, run a 20-cycle test (300 K to 87 K) on D1. Modules cannot be replaced once the cryostat is filled. If D1 fails the test, fall back to D2 at 30%, and test it too. Feedthroughs are sufficient for 30% coverage.

requirements.evidence: Simulation at 30% coverage: D1 52.6, D2 38.3, D3 24.4 PE/MeV. D1 is highest, and 30% is the maximum allowed coverage.

requirements.requirement: At most 5% module failures after 20 thermal cycles (300 K to 87 K)
requirements.evidence: No document or simulation gives thermal-cycling failure data for any candidate. D1's bonded dichroic filter is a plausible risk. A cycling test is needed.

requirements.requirement: Module is one of the three listed designs

requirements.evidence: 30% is within range. The meeting notes confirm enough feedthroughs for up to 30%.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended design and coverage
